description: This file contains unit tests for the KerlinkProvider class within the org.eclipse.hono.adapter.lora.providers package. It verifies functionality such as device ID extraction, payload extraction, and message type identification from LoRa messages using JUnit 5.

classes.name: KerlinkProviderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the KerlinkProvider.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test, creating a new instance of KerlinkProvider.

methods.name: extractDeviceIdFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Tests that the device ID can be successfully extracted from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractPayloadFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Tests that the payload can be successfully extracted from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractTypeFromLoraUplinkMessage
methods.description: Tests that the message type extracted from an uplink message is UPLINK.
